remarks: Welcome to this light and bright two-story home tucked within the peaceful, gated La Villanueva community of West Hills. Offering approximately 2,881 square feet with 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, this spacious home features vaulted ceilings, a generous floor plan, and an abundance of natural light throughout. The inviting family room features a fireplace and wet bar and opens to the spacious eat-in kitchen with ample cabinetry and views of the private backyard. A full bedroom and bathroom downstairs offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or multigenerational living.
